enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping, with the fan running for air circulation
enriched_activities.desc: Lies down on bed. Pulls blanket over body. Closes eyes. Breathes slowly. Turns onto left side. Adjusts pillow. Turns onto right side. Pulls blanket up to shoulders. Remains still. Turns onto back. Stretches arms. Turns onto left side again. Remains still.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, using the toilet, showering and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Wakes up. Sits up. Stands. Walks to bathroom. Turns on light. Uses toilet. Flushes. Washes hands. Turns on shower. Adjusts temperature. Steps in. Washes body. Shampoos. Rinses. Turns off shower. Steps out. Dries off. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Turns off light. Walks out.

enriched_activities.activity: Boiling the kettle, toasting bread and eating breakfast while skim-reading email on phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to kitchen. Turns on kitchen light. Fills kettle with water. Places kettle on base. Turns on kettle. Opens bread bag. Takes out two slices of bread. Places bread in toaster. Presses toaster lever down. Opens phone. Checks email. Kettle boils. Pours hot water into mug. Adds tea bag. Waits for toaster. Toaster pops. Takes out toast. Places toast on plate. Spreads butter. Eats toast. Drinks tea. Continues reading email.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and packing a bag with laptop and notebook for the workday
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bedroom. Opens wardrobe. Takes out shirt. Puts on shirt. Takes out pants. Puts on pants. Puts on socks. Puts on shoes. Opens bag. Picks up laptop. Places laptop in bag. Picks up notebook. Places notebook in bag. Zips bag.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the nonprofit community centre where the community program is run
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bus stop. Waits for bus. Bus arrives. Boards bus. Pays fare. Finds seat. Sits down. Takes out phone. Checks messages. Bus stops. Gets off bus. Walks to community centre. Enters building.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as community program coordinator: setting up the venue, briefing volunteers and running a morning community workshop
enriched_activities.desc: Unlocks door. Enters community centre. Turns on lights. Arranges chairs. Sets up tables. Places materials on tables. Checks projector. Greets volunteers. Briefs volunteers on tasks. Assigns roles. Opens workshop. Welcomes participants. Presents slides. Leads discussion. Answers questions. Monitors time. Closes workshop. Thanks participants.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break, eating a packed lunch and chatting with colleagues
enriched_activities.desc: Sits down at table. Opens lunch box. Takes out sandwich. Unwraps sandwich. Eats sandwich. Drinks water. Talks to colleague. Says: "How was your morning?" Listens. Nods. Continues eating. Finishes lunch. Cleans up.

enriched_activities.activity: Working: meeting partner organisations, updating program records and planning upcoming community events
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to meeting room. Greets partner representatives. Sits down. Discusses collaboration. Takes notes. Agrees on action items. Shakes hands. Returns to desk. Opens computer. Logs in. Opens program records. Updates participant list. Enters data. Saves file. Opens calendar. Plans event dates. Sends emails. Makes phone calls.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting home from the community centre
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bus stop. Waits for bus. Bus arrives. Boards bus. Pays fare. Finds seat. Sits down. Listens to music. Bus stops. Gets off bus. Walks home. Enters house.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking a simple dinner using the induction cooker and oven
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to kitchen. Turns on light. Opens refrigerator. Takes out vegetables. Takes out chicken. Washes vegetables. Chops vegetables. Turns on induction cooker. Places pan on cooker. Adds oil. Adds chicken. Stirs. Preheats oven. Places tray in oven. Sets timer.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating dinner at the kitchen counter
enriched_activities.desc: Sits on stool. Picks up fork. Cuts chicken. Takes a bite. Chews. Swallows. Drinks water. Picks up phone. Scans messages. Puts phone down. Continues eating. Finishes meal.

enriched_activities.activity: Cleaning up the counter and loading the dishwasher
enriched_activities.desc: Stands up. Picks up plate. Scrapes food into bin. Opens dishwasher. Places plate in dishwasher. Picks up glass. Places glass in dishwasher. Picks up utensils. Places utensils in basket. Takes sponge. Wipes counter. Rinses sponge. Adds detergent to dishwasher. Closes dishwasher door. Presses start button.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa watching TV and winding down from the workday
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to living room. Turns on TV. Picks up remote. Sits on sofa. Changes channel. Watches TV. Picks up phone. Scrolls social media. Puts phone down. Watches more TV. Stretches. Yawns. Turns off TV. Stands up.

enriched_activities.activity: Sitting at the desk with the desk lamp on, using the computer to finish program admin and plan tomorrow's schedule
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bedroom. Sits at desk. Turns on desk lamp. Opens laptop. Logs in. Opens program admin software. Updates records. Checks emails. Replies to emails. Opens calendar. Plans tomorrow's schedule. Enters appointments. Saves schedule. Closes laptop. Turns off desk lamp. Stands up.

enriched_activities.activity: Night-time wash: washing face, brushing teeth and changing into sleepwear
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bathroom. Turns on light. Turns on tap. Wets face. Applies cleanser. Rinses face. Dries face. Picks up toothbrush. Applies toothpaste. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Turns off tap. Walks to bedroom. Takes off clothes. Puts on sleepwear.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading quietly in bed with the fan on to wind down
enriched_activities.desc: Turns on fan. Gets into bed. Pulls blanket over legs. Picks up book. Opens book. Reads page. Turns page. Reads more. Turns page. Closes book. Places book on bedside table. Lies down. Closes eyes.
Lies in bed. Closes eyes. Breathes slowly. Turns onto side. Adjusts pillow. Pulls blanket up. Remains still. Turns onto back. Remains still.
